Class PicocliSpock

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.starter.feature.picocli.test.spock.PicocliSpock
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.core.naming.Described, io.micronaut.core.naming.Named, io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered, Feature, TestFeature, PicocliTestFeature
@Requires(property="micronaut.starter.feature.picocli.spock.enabled", value="true", defaultValue="true") @Singleton public class PicocliSpock extends Object implements PicocliTestFeature
Feature for generating Spock tests for Picocli CLI applications.

Provides Spock test templates and integrates them into the project structure.
